en.text: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

zhSimplified.text: 叫了来，给他祝福，并嘱咐他说：「你不要娶的女子为妻。

zhTraditional.text: 叫了來，給他祝福，並囑咐他說：「你不要娶的女子為妻。

en.text: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

zhSimplified.text: 你起身往去，到你外祖家里，在你母舅的女儿中娶一女为妻。

zhTraditional.text: 你起身往去，到你外祖家裏，在你母舅的女兒中娶一女為妻。

en.text: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

zhSimplified.text: 愿全能的 神赐福给你，使你生养众多，成为多族，

zhTraditional.text: 願全能的上帝賜福給你，使你生養眾多，成為多族，

en.text: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

zhSimplified.text: 将应许的福赐给你和你的后裔，使你承受你所寄居的地为业，就是 神赐给的地。」

zhTraditional.text: 將應許的福賜給你和你的後裔，使你承受你所寄居的地為業，就是上帝賜給的地。」

en.text: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

zhSimplified.text: 打发走了，他就往去，到人的儿子那里。是、的母舅。

zhTraditional.text: 打發走了，他就往去，到人的兒子那裏。是、的母舅。

en.text: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

zhSimplified.text: 见已经给祝福，而且打发他往去，在那里娶妻，并见祝福的时候嘱咐他说：「不要娶的女子为妻」，

zhTraditional.text: 見已經給祝福，而且打發他往去，在那裏娶妻，並見祝福的時候囑咐他說：「不要娶的女子為妻」，

en.text: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

zhSimplified.text: 又见听从父母的话往去了，

zhTraditional.text: 又見聽從父母的話往去了，

en.text: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

zhSimplified.text: 就晓得他父亲看不中的女子，

zhTraditional.text: 就曉得他父親看不中的女子，

en.text: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

zhSimplified.text: 便往那里去，在他二妻之外又娶了为妻。她是儿子的女儿，的妹子。

zhTraditional.text: 便往那裏去，在他二妻之外又娶了為妻。她是兒子的女兒，的妹子。

en.text: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

zhSimplified.text: 出了，向走去；

zhTraditional.text: 出了，向走去；

en.text: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

zhSimplified.text: 到了一个地方，因为太阳落了，就在那里住宿，便拾起那地方的一块石头枕在头下，在那里躺卧睡了，

zhTraditional.text: 到了一個地方，因為太陽落了，就在那裏住宿，便拾起那地方的一塊石頭枕在頭下，在那裏躺臥睡了，

en.text: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

zhSimplified.text: 梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯子的头顶着天，有 神的使者在梯子上，上去下来。

zhTraditional.text: 夢見一個梯子立在地上，梯子的頭頂着天，有上帝的使者在梯子上，上去下來。

en.text: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华站在梯子以上，说：「我是耶和华—你祖的 神，也是的 神；我要将你现在所躺卧之地赐给你和你的后裔。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華站在梯子以上，說：「我是耶和華－你祖的上帝，也是的上帝；我要將你現在所躺臥之地賜給你和你的後裔。

en.text: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

zhSimplified.text: 你的后裔必像地上的尘沙那样多，必向东西南北开展；地上万族必因你和你的后裔得福。

zhTraditional.text: 你的後裔必像地上的塵沙那樣多，必向東西南北開展；地上萬族必因你和你的後裔得福。

en.text: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 我也与你同在。你无论往哪里去，我必保佑你，领你归回这地，总不离弃你，直到我成全了向你所应许的。」

zhTraditional.text: 我也與你同在。你無論往哪裏去，我必保佑你，領你歸回這地，總不離棄你，直到我成全了向你所應許的。」

en.text: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

zhSimplified.text: 睡醒了，说：「耶和华真在这里，我竟不知道！」

zhTraditional.text: 睡醒了，說：「耶和華真在這裏，我竟不知道！」

en.text: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

zhSimplified.text: 就惧怕，说：「这地方何等可畏！这不是别的，乃是 神的殿，也是天的门。」

zhTraditional.text: 就懼怕，說：「這地方何等可畏！這不是別的，乃是上帝的殿，也是天的門。」

en.text: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

zhSimplified.text: 清早起来，把所枕的石头立作柱子，浇油在上面。

zhTraditional.text: 清早起來，把所枕的石頭立作柱子，澆油在上面。

en.text: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

zhSimplified.text: 他就给那地方起名叫；但那地方起先名叫。

zhTraditional.text: 他就給那地方起名叫；但那地方起先名叫。

en.text: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

zhSimplified.text: 许愿说：「 神若与我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又给我食物吃，衣服穿，

zhTraditional.text: 許願說：「上帝若與我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又給我食物吃，衣服穿，

en.text: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,

zhSimplified.text: 使我平平安安地回到我父亲的家，我就必以耶和华为我的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 使我平平安安地回到我父親的家，我就必以耶和華為我的上帝。

en.text: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 我所立为柱子的石头也必作 神的殿；凡你所赐给我的，我必将十分之一献给你。」

zhTraditional.text: 我所立為柱子的石頭也必作上帝的殿；凡你所賜給我的，我必將十分之一獻給你。」
